name: MCL Prior-Session Boundary Auction Lifecycle
hypothesis: Prior-session boundary acceptance and failure have stable after-cost expectancy only under one branch-aware combination of auction ownership, structural invalidation, and failed-auction profit memory; the discovery-selected semantic owner must transfer unchanged to validation.
signal: The exact 414 outcome-blind V30 prior-session events; no boundary, side, verdict, direction, clock, or cadence change is allowed.

portfolio_lifecycle.entry: one matched-suffix MCL contract at the frozen next one-minute open
portfolio_lifecycle.opposite_direction: close and reverse at the same next one-minute open
portfolio_lifecycle.pre_halt: flat at the 16:55 ET MCL close; no census entry after 16:25 ET
portfolio_lifecycle.clock_or_contract_reset: close at the last continuous MCL close and never reopen

semantic_laws.acceptance_structural_stop: the crossed prior-session MCL high for a long or low for a short
semantic_laws.failure_structural_stop: the first excursion MCL high for a short or low for a long
semantic_laws.failure_profit_memory: failed-auction positions only: after a completed one-minute bar establishes 0.5% MFE, protect 25% of running MFE from the next bar
semantic_laws.intrabar_order: structural stop, then armed profit memory, then MFE/MAE update; adverse gaps fill at the opening price

discovery_eligibility.cohorts: up/down, acceptance/failure, and high/low boundary sides each positive under primary and stress

selection_law: Among discovery-eligible owners maximize stress PnL/DD, then primary PnL/DD, then stress net, then minimize primary DD. Only that owner may open validation and full outcomes.
validation_law: The selected owner independently satisfies every discovery eligibility gate on validation.

full_law.cohorts: up/down, acceptance/failure, and high/low sides positive under primary and stress

control: After selection only, invert identical selected holds under primary costs; it cannot select or rescue.
if_no_discovery_owner: Reject prior-session auction lifecycle before validation; do not sweep boundaries, confirmation, stops, activation, retention, session exit, timeout, or costs.
if_development_passes: Preserve as outcome-exposed development only. Missing July-2023 history, unseen prospective evidence, runtime parity, native transport, margin, preview, allocation, restart, and safety remain mandatory before a crown or capital authority.
